title: Merge Sort Array
problem: Given an array of integers nums, sort the array in ascending order using Merge Sort.
hints: Divide the array in halves recursively. Merge the two sorted halves back together using two pointers.
code:
def solution(nums):
    if len(nums) <= 1: return nums
    mid = len(nums) // 2
    left = solution(nums[:mid])
    right = solution(nums[mid:])
    res = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] < right[j]:
            res.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            res.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    res.extend(left[i:])
    res.extend(right[j:])
    return res
